name: io.github.Servosity/windows-server-mcp
title: Windows Server MCP
description: Agentless Windows Server health checks over WinRM: one verdict per server, a diffable inventory

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the WinRM account shared by servers that have no password stored with servers login.

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: WinRM account name (a local or domain account in the server's Administrators group).

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to offer only tools that change nothing: services restart, services start, health and inventory snapshot are removed. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local store: health prints verdicts without recording history or events, and inventory snapshot is refused. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank. The CLI's internal request surface is the fixed https://winrm.invalid; any other value is refused. Servers come only from the config file's [[servers]] entries.

environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on WinRM requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
